column3: “the banners” renders “the signs (otot),” and “at a distance” renders “from opposite.”
“on the east side toward the sunrise” renders the doubled “eastward, toward sunrise,” and “by their armies” renders “by their hosts” (throughout the chapter).
“next to him” renders “upon him” (also in verses 12, 20 and 27).
NASB supplies “Then comes” (also in verses 14, 22 and 29).
NASB reads “Deuel” as in 1:14; the Hebrew here has “Reuel.”
“every man in his place” renders “each at his hand.”
